description:
He’s flirted, fallen in love, hooked up, and broken up. He’s even proposed with a candy ring. But now, in the new series Let’s Marry Harry, Harry Jowsey’s ready for the real thing.
After traveling all across the Netflix Reality Universe in search of his soulmate (see: Too Hot to Handle and Perfect Match as evidence), Jowsey will date a new pool of potential matches in hopes of finding what he truly wants: authentic love and marriage. “Having a show of my own is incredible, but also having my family at Netflix stop at no end to help me find the love of my life is the most amazing feeling,” Jowsey tells Tudum about the upcoming dating series.
If you’ve always had a thing for the NRU’s most notorious bachelor, click the portal above to apply for a chance to be a part of his search for his soulmate. But keep in mind, to marry Harry, he’s not the only one you’ll need to hit it off with. You’ll also need to make a good impression on his friends.
Jowsey is handing the reins of his love life to those who know him best. In Let’s Marry Harry, his closest confidants, including podcast host Alex Cooper, step in to make the tough calls. With their help, Jowsey just might graduate from player to life partner. “I’m looking forward to doing this alongside one of my best friends, Alex Cooper. She is a big sister to me, and I know she’ll help me to not be a silly sausage while keeping me grounded,” he says. “I haven’t necessarily been the best at keeping relationships, but I knew if I was going to give love one last shot after all the work I’ve been putting into myself, I’d need Alex to help keep me in check while searching for a potential future wife.”
Cooper is best known for co-creating and hosting the Spotify comedy advice podcast Call Her Daddy. Cooper also founded and runs The Unwell Network, which produces other podcasts, including Boyfriend Material with Harry Jowsey, where he honestly answers dating, sex, and relationships questions from the male perspective. Unwell is also the production company behind Let’s Marry Harry, and Cooper will serve as an executive producer on the series alongside Matt Kaplan and Mina Lefevre.
